item.title: Datto Endpoint Backup for PC - Backup and Restore - Service Disruption for Customers Hosted on Cloud Siris 299242 [investigating]
item.description:
We are aware of a problem where Datto Endpoint Backup for PC users hosted on Cloud Siris 299242 may experience degraded backup and recovery performance..
The Kaseya Engineering Team is investigating the issue and working towards a resolution.
Should you need any additional questions or require assistance, please contact our support team at https://helpdesk.kaseya.com/hc/en-gb#/contact
Subscribe to the Kaseya Status Page for up-to-date information at https://status.kaseya.com/

item.title: Datto Networking - Secure Edge Data Usage Reporting Issue [resolved]
item.description:
The issue preventing Secure Edge administrators from viewing recent usage information within Datto Network Manager has been resolved.
Queued data has finished processing, and usage metrics are now available as expected. We appreciate your patience while we worked through this issue.
Subscribe to the Kaseya Status Page for up to date information at https://status.kaseya.com/
